extracted.name: Mexican Rice & Beef Tacos
extracted.description: These beef and Mexican rice tacos with bell peppers and onions are quick and easy — just what you need after a busy day.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons I Can't Believe It's Not Butter!® Spread, divided
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 medium green or red bell pepper, chopped
1 (5.4 ounce) package Knorr® Fiesta Sides™ - Mexican Rice
instruction_lines: Melt 1 tablespoon butter spread in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef, season with salt and pepper, and cook until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Melt remaining 1 tablespoon butter spread in same skillet over medium-high heat. Add bell pepper and onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in water, rice, and tomato; increase heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 7 minutes. Stir in beef and cook until heated through.
Spoon beef and rice mixture into taco shells and serve.
